# C++ common types

These type-safe values correspond directly to the C11 contracts.

## `Status`

```cpp
enum class corelib::Status;
```

Type-safe Corelib operation status.

Values: `Ok`, `InvalidArgument`, `InvalidState`, `InvalidFrame`, `Unsupported`, `CapacityExceeded`, `Busy`, `NotFound`, `Expired`, `Reentrant`.

## `SendResult`

```cpp
enum class corelib::SendResult;
```

Type-safe transport send result.

Values: `Accepted`, `Busy`, `Failed`.

## `Action`

```cpp
enum class corelib::Action;
```

Generic transaction action.

Values: `CommonRequest`, `CommonPublish`, `CommonResponse`, `ShareRequest`, `SharePublish`, `ShareResponse`.

## `Result`

```cpp
enum class corelib::Result;
```

Application transaction result.

Values: `Success`, `Unsupported`, `Busy`, `InvalidRequest`, `InternalError`.

## `SessionState`

```cpp
enum class corelib::SessionState;
```

Endpoint session state.

Values: `Inactive`, `Active`, `Stale`.

## `Diagnostic`

```cpp
enum class corelib::Diagnostic;
```

Recoverable Corelib diagnostic category.

Values: `InvalidFrame`, `InvalidMessage`, `ResourceLimit`, `SendFailed`, `RequestExpired`, `TimeReversed`.

## `PayloadKind`

```cpp
enum class corelib::PayloadKind;
```

Selects the application payload namespace.

Values: `Common`, `Share`.

## `ControlStatus`

```cpp
enum class corelib::ControlStatus;
```

Type-safe PFP control completion status.

Values: `Success`, `Malformed`, `Unsupported`, `Conflict`, `DuplicateIdentity`, `NoRoute`, `HopLimit`, `SessionRejected`, `ResourceLimit`.

## `LinkRole`

```cpp
enum class corelib::LinkRole;
```

Direction of a dedicated gateway link.

Values: `Upstream`, `Downstream`.
